title: Bluest Account: Out-of-network ATM fees
summary: This document explains Rho-Bank’s “out-of-network ATM” fee for the Bluest Account: $2.00 per cash withdrawal at an ATM not in Rho-Bank’s network. It notes the fee posts as a separate line item, and any ATM operator surcharge is in addition to Rho-Bank’s fee.
faqs: When will I be charged an out-of-network ATM fee on my Bluest Account?
